about: Test questions for the search evaluation (server/scripts/evalSearch.ts). Each question lists the file(s) that answer it: finding any one of them in the top 8 counts as found. kind: plain = plain English, name = names something in the code, folder = uses 'Search in'. If code moves, update 'expect'.
